name: Digital March: Egg Theory
summary:
It’s 2 A.M. at the Crown Diner. Rain on the windows. Your friend Arlo just turned a card game into fortune-telling, and the four girls by the school gate are saying it’s more than a game.

Digital March: Egg Theory is a card-dueling RPG in the spirit of the PS1 classics. Build your deck from a fortune-teller’s spread, enter a tournament that spans the city, and find out what the Egg Theory club means when they say the moon looks like a shell.
